coaching.coaching: Today's 5 km at an 8:00 / km pace kept your average HR at 147 bpm, comfortably below your MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, which is excellent. Your max HR spiked to 163 bpm, so watch for short bursts that push you over the limit. Cadence was strong at 178 spm and power at 185 W, showing good form.
